page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No marginal notes. A faint mark at the lower right is outside the printed text and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Obelo, adesse; quo saepius aderunt illa,
haec vero aberunt, eo ἀκιβδηλίας[?] frequentiora erunt τεκμήρια:
his duobus argumentis tertium accedit, textus cum te-
nostris Biblicis haec & similia de Editio-
ndimus, quae Asterisco notata sunt, abesse;
rum sententiae accedere, qui illius pror-
quantis distat parasangis? Nec istae differentiae

page.notes: The Greek words ἀκιβδηλίας and ἀκιβδήλα are small and partly smudged in the scan; the accents and breathings are doubtful, so they are marked [?]. The word "hendit" is printed on its own line at the right margin, as the second half of "depre-hendit". The page number is printed as "414" with a small raised mark on the 1, read here as 414. The faint mark in the lower right corner is not printed text.
